entries.title: Trump says AI safety fears a 'hoax' as he rejects calls for greater safeguards
entries.snippet: The US president's comments come after Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark told the BBC an AI "kill switch" may need to be mandatory.

entries.title: AI regulation faces political deadlock as calls grow for Congress to act
entries.snippet: With Trump opposed and Congress divided, new safety legislation on AI is unlikely to pass anytime soon despite mounting pressure.

entries.title: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
entries.snippet: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.

entries.title: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win
entries.snippet: He becomes the first person to win two lead acting prizes in one night at the prestigious TV ceremony.

entries.title: Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
entries.snippet: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.

entries.title: US confirms for first time it has deployed space weapons
entries.snippet: The US Air Force Secretary says the weapons are necessary to defend the country against enemy action.

entries.title: Donald Trump Jr and Bettina Trump say Putin ally paid for some wedding festivities as a 'gift'

entries.title: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace
entries.snippet: The origin of the drone is currently unknown, but authorities say it likely entered Lithuania from neighbouring Belarus, an ally of Russia.

entries.title: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87
entries.snippet: The "Sultan of Sequins" created iconic and dazzling costumes for stars including Cher, Tina Turner and Elton John.

entries.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
entries.snippet: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.

entries.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
entries.snippet: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

entries.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump's plan to restrict mail-in ballots
entries.snippet: The Trump administration had asked the court to lift a federal judge's temporary block on new rules for mail-in ballots.

entries.title: China tightens travel restrictions for citizens
entries.snippet: Observers say the new rules will further tighten the Chinese government's control over its citizens.

entries.title: Israeli minister threatens to revoke filmmakers' citizenship over Gaza documentary
entries.snippet: The film accuses the Israeli army of mass civilian killing in Gaza, and Israeli officials say it could be treasonous.

entries.title: US scraps limits on emissions from coal and gas power plants
entries.snippet: The Environment Protection Agency says the move will save the country billions of dollars and reduce energy prices.

entries.title: Malaysian boy acquitted for murder of schoolgirl on grounds of insanity
entries.snippet: The killing of the 16-year-old nearly a year ago had shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about social media.

entries.title: Immigrants held in small outdoor cages at 'Alligator Alcatraz' in Florida, investigators find
entries.snippet: DHS inspectors say they found the immigration-detention centre violated basic standards for hygiene, medical care, food and safety.

entries.title: Africa's richest man launches continent's biggest share sale
entries.snippet: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote says he wants ordinary people to share in the success of his oil refinery.

entries.title: Ukraine's postal workers deliver lifeline under Russian fire
entries.snippet: The state post service delivers pensions, medicine and letters to people just miles from the front.

entries.title: Russians seek answers over hundreds missing after Ukraine's 2024 incursion
entries.snippet: Officials say more than 300 Russians remain missing after the 2024 Kursk offensive, but no-one really knows the true figure.

entries.title: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers
entries.snippet: Farmers in states bordering Canada say they are reeling from President Trump's trade wars and resulting retaliatory tariffs. And it's just not neighborly.

entries.title: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.

entries.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
entries.snippet: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.

entries.title: NATO jets down drone in Lithuanian airspace
entries.snippet: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv.

entries.title: Get ready for yet another cost when buying a home: Junk fees
entries.snippet: Some real estate agents and researchers say home buyers and sellers should not pay this out-of-pocket fee.

entries.title: NASA rushed engineers out of their labs. They say it risks future space missions
entries.snippet: NASA employees say they've lost vital equipment and staff needed to make sophisticated spacecraft amid the agency's abrupt relocations over the past several months.

entries.title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon to share a stage to promote curbs on AI
entries.snippet: The poles of U.S. politics are coming together over AI. Sanders and Bannon will appear at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington, D.C., to convince Congress to work faster to curb the impact of AI.

entries.title: This bill could reshape crypto in America -- and it's sparking a major battle
entries.snippet: The legislation would establish rules of the road for the crypto sector for the first time — but opponents are up in arms, and the bill faces an uncertain prospect in the Senate.

entries.title: For thousands of Haitians in the U.S., end of protected status brings fear, grief and defiance
entries.snippet: Haitians in the U.S. lost their Temporary Protected Status under Trump's immigration crackdown. Now facing deportation to a homeland wracked by gang violence, disease and extreme poverty, Haitians in Miami are meeting the moment with grief, anger, and courage.

entries.title: Supreme Court refuses to allow Trump's mail voting restrictions for the midterms
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court has rejected President Trump's push for new mail-in voting restrictions for the midterm election.

entries.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump mail ballot restrictions ahead of midterms
entries.snippet: The decision allows states to continue sending ballots under existing processes used by nearly one-third of voters.

entries.title: Mahmoud Khalil lawsuit says Columbia University failed to protect pro-Palestinian activists
entries.snippet: The university's "deliberate indifference" led to the doxing of multiple group members and Khalil's detention by immigration agents, according to the civil rights lawsuit filed in federal court in New York City.

entries.title: Trump pushes back as AI leaders fuel calls to rein in rapidly advancing technology

entries.title: WATCH: McConnell returns to the Senate for the first time since his June hospitalization
entries.snippet: Republican Sen. Mitch McConnell of Kentucky has returned to the Senate after a long absence. The 94-year-old senator has not been to the U.S. Capitol since June 14, when he was hospitalized for a fall in his home.

entries.title: More than 1.2 million children have lost SNAP benefits since last July. Experts explain why
entries.snippet: Experts say that the drop is a cause for worry, and that it's unlikely that the need for food assistance has dropped.

entries.title: Tamara Keith and Amy Walter on Washington's response to AI and data center concerns

entries.title: Turkish authorities launch crackdown on LGBTQ+ and HIV support groups
entries.snippet: Turkish authorities cracked down on multiple LGBTQ+ groups and individuals early Sunday morning, detaining dozens of members, breaking into association offices and raiding popular hangouts.

entries.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine will pause strikes on Russia if Kremlin spares critical infrastructure
entries.snippet: His comments Monday follow President Donald Trump's claim that Russia and Ukraine agreed not to target each other's energy infrastructure.

entries.title: Pope celebrates his 71st birthday but it's Vatican employees who get the gift
entries.snippet: The Vatican published a papal decree repealing 2021 salary cuts that Pope Francis had imposed on many Vatican employees as part of the Holy See's COVID-19 cost-saving measures.

entries.title: Man pleads not guilty in the hanging death of Tasia Fortune in Mississippi
entries.snippet: A man charged with murder in the hanging of a Black woman in Mississippi pleaded not guilty Monday at his first court appearance.

entries.title: Houthis seize 2 strategic Red Sea islands, and other Mideast developments
entries.snippet: Yemen's Houthi rebels have seized the strategic islands of Greater and Lesser Hanish in the southern Red Sea. This move strengthens their control over a key maritime shipping route.

entries.title: After decades of insurgency, Muslim region in Philippines votes in its first parliamentary election
entries.snippet: The vote on Monday marks a crucial step toward self-rule after decades of insurgency in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Patel testifies on FBI oversight before Senate panel amid troubled tenure
entries.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel is set to appear before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Tuesday for an oversight hearing on the nation's lead law enforcement agency.

entries.title: Live Results: Delaware midterm primaries
entries.snippet: Delaware's Democratic U.S. senator, U.S. representative and state attorney general will go before voters in a state primary Tuesday as they seek reelection.

entries.title: Some Democrats recalibrating approach to transgender issues
entries.snippet: An increasing number of Democratic leaders have begun to push back against their party's unflinching support for the transgender community this midterm season.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Iran: 'Woman, Life, Freedom' lives on despite war
entries.snippet: The death of Jina Mahsa Amini triggered a resistance movement in Iran. Four years later, the Iranian regime endures — but so does the legacy of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests.

entries.title: Bangladesh court sentences 7 Hasina allies to death
entries.snippet: The latest verdict brings to 22 the number of death sentences handed down in cases stemming from the 2024 uprising that ended Sheikh Hasina's 15-year rule.

entries.title: Berlin election driven by radical ideas
entries.snippet: The results of the Berlin election are as hard to predict as ever. Three parties are vying for first place, including the socialist Left Party and the far-right AfD. But one issue is most important to Berliners.

entries.title: Germany news: Police find arms depot near highway
entries.snippet: Police have found a stash of rifles, pistols and other firearms near a road in the western state of Rhineland-Palatinate. Meanwhile, Defense Minister Pistorius is off to Washington for talks with his US counterpart.

entries.title: East German leader styles self as one-woman bulwark to AfD
entries.snippet: Manuela Schwesig of the center-left SPD has governed the state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, on the Baltic Sea coast, since 2017. Ahead of this weekend's election, she is campaigning against the far right.

entries.title: US confirms it has weapons in space
entries.snippet: The US Space Force justified the weapons deployment by citing its two biggest geopolitical rivals — Russia and China. Beijing responded by urging Washington to "stop preparing for war" in outer space.

entries.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Lithuania
entries.snippet: The drone, which is believed to have entered Lithuanian airspace from Belarus, was shot down by an Italian fighter jet in between the cities of Vilnius and Kaunas. There have been no reports of casualties or damage.

entries.title: Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter
entries.snippet: Denmark has summoned Russia's ambassador over a Baltic Sea encounter that Copenhagen says is part of an increasingly aggressive pattern of Russian behavior.

entries.title: China tightens travel rules over tech security
entries.snippet: Beijing says the new rules, which could also apply to foreign and Taiwanese nationals, are aimed at safeguarding "national security."

entries.title: Netherlands: Suspected sabotage disrupts train services
entries.snippet: A major outage has hit parts of the Dutch railway system after objects were found placed across lines, authorities say. The company responsible for rail infrastructure says it suspects deliberate wrongdoing.

entries.title: India: Meta to report child abuse cases to law enforcement
entries.snippet: Tech giant Meta will now directly report child safety-related cases to India's cybercrime portal, according to media reports. DW has more.

entries.title: Why top AI researchers are warning about human extinction
entries.snippet: Could artificial intelligence pose an existential threat to humanity? Some leading researchers are warning against an unregulated race toward AI superintelligence.

entries.title: El Salvador court hands down first life sentence for femicide
entries.snippet: The landmark conviction comes 42 days after the killing of a woman in Santa Ana who prosecutors said was stalked and harassed by her neighbor.

entries.title: Iran and America: A tale of two lands and the pistachio between them
entries.snippet: The pistachios sold across the United States have a surprising history: California's trees trace their roots to Iran. Now both regions face the same threat: their farmland is sinking as groundwater disappears.

entries.title: Europe launches two climate observation satellites
entries.snippet: The European Space Agency has put two satellites into orbit to take a closer look at the impact of climate change. One of them will focus particularly on plant life.

entries.title: US scraps greenhouse gas rules for power plants
entries.snippet: The Environmental Protection Agency said it was repealing Biden-era limits on emissions made by power plants, in the "largest power sector deregulation action ever."

entries.title: US Supreme Court denies Trump bid to restrict mail-in ballots
entries.snippet: The court said election officials do not have sufficient time to implement the rule before the November midterms. Trump has argued, without providing evidence, that the system is vulnerable to fraud.

entries.title: Germany news: Merz urges CDU discipline as pressure grows
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has urged his party to stay disciplined as pressure grows over his leadership. Meanwhile, Germany's homeownership rate has fallen to its lowest level in 20 years.

entries.title: Kremlin-linked Russian oligarch helped fund Trump Jr.'s wedding celebration
entries.snippet: Trump's son and his wife confirmed reports that Umar Kremlev paid for parts of the festivities. Kremlev was awarded the "Order of Friendship" by Putin earlier this year.
